worksheets.title: το + three essential nouns
worksheets.rule: το means “the” before one neuter noun. Learn το and the noun together as one vocabulary unit.
ruleSteps: Say το and the noun without separating them.
Nouns ending in -ο or -ι are often neuter.
Use the ending only as a clue; keep the article with the noun.

worksheets.title: Definite το versus indefinite ένα
worksheets.rule: Use το for “the” with one neuter noun. Use ένα for “a” or “one” neuter noun.
ruleSteps: το νερό means the water.
ένα νερό means a water / one water.
Choose from the English meaning, not by habit.

exercises.explanation: το νερό uses the definite article because it means “the water.”

worksheets.title: Definite η/ο versus μία/ένας
worksheets.rule: Use η or ο for “the.” Use μία with one feminine noun and ένας with one masculine noun for “a/one” in the subject form.
ruleSteps: η τσάντα means the bag; μία τσάντα means a bag.
ο χάρτης means the map; ένας χάρτης means a map.
Object forms will be taught in a later grammar pack.

exercises.explanation: η πόρτα uses the definite article because it means “the door.”
η σαλάτα uses the definite article because it means “the salad.”
The complete Greek unit is ο χάρτης.
ο σταθμός uses the definite article because it means “the station.”
η σαλάτα uses the definite article because it means “the salad.”
